positions.as_written: Ask them to straighten the knee as far as they can and measure the angle achieved, stating the method used.
Ask them to bend it as far as they can, sliding the heel towards the buttock, and measure that angle.
Repeat on the other side and record both, since the comparison is part of the measurement.
Ask them to hold the knee straight against gravity with the leg lifted, which tests the extensor mechanism rather than the range.
